story:
Hi, I'm Ashley, the maker behind Made in the Mood. I am a nurse, married for 20+ years, mom of two, and jewelry making started as a creative outlet in the middle of a very full life.

In 2026, I decided to take that hobby seriously and build a small business around the things I love: color, texture, and jewelry that feels personal. I make playful, easy-to-wear pieces, along with fun bold statement designs for days when you want to stand out.

Each piece is designed and assembled by hand in my Utah workspace. I hope you find something here that feels like you. Choose your mood!
